title: Chapter 1
text: From #1 New York Times bestselling author Brandon Sanderson. Winner of the 2013 Hugo Award for Best Novella. Shai is a Forger, a foreigner who can flawlessly copy and re-create any item by rewriting its history with skillful magic. Condemned to death after trying to steal the Moon Scepter, she is given one opportunity to save herself. Though her skill as a Forger is considered an abomination by her captors, Shai will attempt to create a new soul for the emperor, who is almost dead. Probing deeply into his life, she discovers Emperor Ashravan’s truest nature—and the opportunity to exploit it. Her only possible ally is one who is truly loyal to the emperor, but councilor Gaotona must overcome his prejudices to understand that Shai’s forgery is as much artistry as it is deception. Time is running out for Shai. Forging, while deducing the motivations of her captors, she needs a perfect plan to escape…
